newsitem.title: USA: Specialty Retail to phase out owned stores.
newsitem.headline: Specialty Retail to phase out owned stores.

text.p: Specialty Retail Group Inc said Friday after the market closed that its Building Blocks subsidiary plans to phase out its company-operated stores and will attempt to shift to an all-franchised store operation by spring 1997.
Building Blocks said it plans to close some of its stores before the upcoming holiday season and to consolidate their inventories at its other stores.

The company said its franchising subsidiary, Building Blocks Franchise Corp, plans to continue to aggressively seek franchisees to acquire the leases, inventories and fixtures of the stores that will remain in operation through the holiday season, and for new stores.
Two new franchises have already been sold for stores that will open in 1996, in Dallas, Texas and Chicago, Illinois.

The company said it anticipated that it would conclude transactions this month for the transfer to franchisees of at least two Building Blocks-operated stores and the sale for cash of their inventories and fixtures.
